name: agent-dev
description: Developer-focused workflows for shaping and simplifying software.

interface.longDescription: Agent Dev packages developer workflows for mapping greenfield project decisions and for ruthless, evidence-backed repo cleanup. It identifies human-owned gates, safe agent decisions, empirical questions, deferred work, stale docs, unused code, duplicate scripts, dead flags, speculative abstractions, and implementation drift.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Dev to shape a software project or find stale, unused, duplicated, speculative, or misleading repo surfaces.
